name: Obie Obiacoro
office: Rowland Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Obie Obiacoro is an office administrator running for the Rowland Unified School Board. He was elected to the school site council at Stanley G. Oswalt Academy in 2012. In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, Obiacoro said the district's top needs are strengthening student achievement and sustaining student well-being. He wants to ensure access to high-quality instruction and to expand access to counseling and mental-health resources. He said the school board should set a clear vision and allocate resources responsibly.
